build_BEVNet: build a BEVNet model with ResNet Bottleneck blocks for bird's eye view feature extraction
create_BEVNet_with_confidence: create a BEVNet model with an optional confidence prediction head enabled
run_BEVNet_forward: run the BEVNet forward pass to extract features and produce output predictions
review_BEVNet_init: review the BEVNet _init method to understand how Bottleneck blocks and AdaptationBlock are configured
refactor_BEVNet_padding: refactor the BEVNet padding mode configuration to support non-zero padding strategies
